notes.title: END UP ALONE UPDATE V 0.1
notes.content:
[b]We’re back with a smaller update containing bug fixes for the End up alone.[/b]



[i]- 30% increase in player speed
- Fixing vaccine problems
- Fixed some areas where FPS dropped
- Fixed the player seat
- Steam Achievement Settings
- Fixing the problem of dark places
- Fixing the music
- Fixed the pause when saving and specifying the locations to be saved
- Rearranged some icons
- Repair of items that were not removed or boxes and lockers were not opened

- Configure the map in the inventory section[/i]
